verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Lowenstein x Clerky partnership. It offers standardized incorporation documents: bylaws, director and officer appointments, founder stock issuances and 83(b) forms. However, it is framed as something 'clients can' use and is paid ($299 per use or a lifetime package, plus $149 for a managed 83(b) add-on), so it is neither free nor clearly open to non-clients. Missing for 10: free access, explicit availability to non-clients, SAFE/term sheet generators or templates, NDA templates, downloadable public form library.
